items_flat.title_en: Anthropic prices IPO at $83, raises $81.3B, ANT trading begins Nov 19
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic以每股83美元定價IPO，募資813億美元，ANT將於11月19日開始交易
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic officially priced its IPO at $83 per share for 980 million Class A shares (956.35 million sold by the company), raising about $81.3 billion and valuing the firm at roughly $1.5 trillion fully diluted. Shares are expected to begin trading on Nasdaq under ANT on November 19, with the offering set to close on November 20.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic正式將IPO定價為每股83美元，共980百萬股A類普通股（公司出售956.35百萬股），募資約813億美元，全面稀釋後估值約1.5兆美元。股票預計於11月19日在Nasdaq以ANT代碼開始交易，發行預計11月20日完成。
items_flat.analysis_en: Final pricing above the $70-78 range and upsizing confirm strong demand for the first pure-play frontier AI lab IPO despite market volatility and high compute costs. First-day trading will test whether public markets sustain the private valuations seen in recent AI funding rounds.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 最終定價高於70-78美元區間並擴大發行規模，確認市場對首家純前沿AI實驗室IPO的強烈需求，儘管存在市場波動與高算力成本。首日交易將檢驗公開市場能否維持近期AI融資的私人估值水準。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC priced its initial public offering of its Class A common stock at $83.00 per share.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日Anthropic, PBC將其A類普通股首次公開發行定價為每股83.00美元。

links.label: Anthropic IPO website / SEC filings via Stock Titan

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with better efficiency and lower cost
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6.2 Astra與Sol，效率更高且成本更低
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol on November 17, available in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API for Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Edu users. Astra targets hard professional and scientific work at lower cost per task than prior Astra; Sol offers efficient everyday performance near Astra levels.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月17日推出GPT-6.2 Astra與Sol，提供給Plus、Pro、Enterprise與Edu用戶在ChatGPT Work、Codex與API中使用。Astra針對艱鉅專業與科學工作，每任務成本低於先前Astra；Sol則提供接近Astra水準的高效日常表現。
items_flat.analysis_en: The launch continues OpenAI’s focus on cost-efficient frontier performance rather than raw capability jumps, with Astra claiming better results on professional evals at a fraction of prior costs. Real-world adoption will hinge on whether efficiency gains hold in production agent workflows.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此次發布延續OpenAI對成本效率前沿表現的重視，而非單純能力跳躍，Astra在專業評估上宣稱以更低成本取得更好結果。實際採用將取決於效率提升是否能在生產代理工作流中持續。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing GPT‑6.2 Astra, our new frontier model for your hardest projects, and GPT‑6.2 Sol, our efficient, versatile model for everyday work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出GPT‑6.2 Astra，針對最艱鉅專案的新前沿模型，以及GPT‑6.2 Sol，針對日常工作的高效多用途模型。

items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon for fast frontier-level task completion
items_flat.title_zh: Google推出Gemini 4 Neon，實現快速前沿級任務完成
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 4 Neon on November 18, priced at $3/$15 per million tokens with a 1 million-token context window. It targets complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science with fast end-to-end completion, ranking #3 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at xhigh and #1 on the Coding Agent Index.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind於11月18日推出Gemini 4 Neon，定價為每百萬token 3/15美元，擁有100萬token上下文窗口。它針對複雜軟體工程、知識工作與科學，強調快速端到端完成，在Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index的xhigh設定排名第3，並在Coding Agent Index排名第1。
items_flat.analysis_en: Neon fills a high-velocity tier between larger Gemini 4 models, emphasizing cost and speed for agentic workflows while claiming competitive benchmarks. Adoption will depend on real-world reliability in long-running production agents versus pure benchmark scores.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Neon填補較大Gemini 4模型之間的高速度層級，強調代理工作流的成本與速度，同時宣稱具有競爭力的基準成績。採用將取決於長期生產代理中的實際可靠性，而非單純基準分數。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Neon — bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日，我們推出Gemini 4 Neon——為複雜軟體工程、知識工作與科學工作流帶來前沿級智能與快速端到端任務完成。

items_flat.title_en: Google expands Gemini 4 Hydrogen for speed, agents, Tasks, and robotics
items_flat.title_zh: Google擴展Gemini 4 Hydrogen，用於速度、代理、Tasks與機器人
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind’s Gemini 4 Hydrogen, introduced for everyday coding and agentic workflows at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens, is rolling out broadly in the Gemini app, Search, AI Studio, and API. It powers free Tasks in six countries and new robotics integrations.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind的Gemini 4 Hydrogen針對日常編碼與代理工作流推出，定價為每百萬token 1.50/7.50美元，正廣泛在Gemini應用、Search、AI Studio與API中推出。它支援六國免費Tasks與新機器人整合。
items_flat.analysis_en: Hydrogen positions Google to compete on high-velocity agent and coding tasks while pairing with larger models like Carbon and Argon. Broader free access and robotics integration expand its reach beyond paid developer tiers.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Hydrogen讓Google能在高速度代理與編碼任務上競爭，並與Carbon和Argon等較大模型搭配。更廣泛的免費存取與機器人整合，將其觸及範圍擴展至付費開發者層級之外。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，將尖端智能帶給每個人——以速度與效率服務日常編碼與代理工作流。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI reports agents complete nearly half of multi-hour research tasks
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI報告代理可獨立完成近半數多小時研究任務
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published data on November 18 showing coding agents completing 46% of tasks estimated to take researchers two to four hours (up from 23% in March) and 35% of four-to-eight-hour tasks. Human involvement remains central, with safety and alignment seeing the largest growth in research effort.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月18日公布數據，顯示編碼代理可獨立完成估計需研究員兩至四小時的任務達46%（三月時為23%），四至八小時任務達35%。人類參與仍是核心，安全與對齊領域研究投入成長最大。
items_flat.analysis_en: The data quantifies uneven AI uplift in research, highlighting both rapid agent progress and persistent human bottlenecks. It also signals OpenAI’s push for industry norms on tracking recursive self-improvement indicators.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 數據量化了研究中AI提升的不均衡，突顯代理快速進展與持續的人類瓶頸。它也顯示OpenAI推動產業追蹤遞迴自我改進指標的規範。
items_flat.quote: Agents now complete nearly half of two-to-four-hour research tasks on their own. But humans are still central to AI development.
items_flat.quote_zh: 代理現在可獨立完成近半數兩至四小時研究任務。但人類仍是AI開發的核心。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI models deliver up to 14% PPA gains on AMD GPU designs
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI模型在AMD GPU設計上帶來最高14% PPA提升
items_flat.summary_en: On November 18 OpenAI detailed how its models reduced standard-cell area by ~13% in Jalapeño’s vector unit and 10% in the matrix unit, with silicon-proven results. Collaboration with AMD yielded up to 14% PPA improvement on flagship GPU IP in under five months, with some changes already in manufacturing designs.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月18日詳述其模型將Jalapeño向量單元標準單元面積減少約13%、矩陣單元減少10%，並經矽片驗證。與AMD合作在旗艦GPU IP上帶來最高14% PPA提升，不到五個月完成，部分變更已納入製造設計。
items_flat.analysis_en: These results show frontier models contributing net-new hardware optimizations that reach production silicon, compressing traditional design timelines. Independent verification of the AMD gains remains limited to company-reported data.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些結果顯示前沿模型可貢獻淨新硬體優化並達到生產矽片，壓縮傳統設計時間表。AMD提升的獨立驗證仍限於公司報告數據。
items_flat.quote: This represents roughly a year of progress achieved in less than 5 months–unprecedented results at the frontier of chip design.
items_flat.quote_zh: 這代表不到五個月達成約一年的進展——晶片設計前沿的前所未有結果。

items_flat.title_en: Google rolls out Genie 4 in Project Genie for AI Ultra subscribers
items_flat.title_zh: Google為AI Ultra訂閱者在Project Genie中推出Genie 4
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind made Genie 4 available on November 18 in an updated Project Genie experience for eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers. It adds real-time mid-session prompting, native audio, a creation agent, and a community gallery, alongside Genie 3 upgrades for longer sessions.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind於11月18日在更新的Project Genie體驗中為符合資格的Google AI Ultra訂閱者提供Genie 4。它加入即時會話中提示、原生音訊、創作代理與社群畫廊，並升級Genie 3以支援更長會話。
items_flat.analysis_en: Genie 4 advances interactive world models toward more responsive, audio-enabled experiences while remaining in research preview. Broad adoption is constrained by the Ultra subscription gate and acknowledged limitations in physics and long-term consistency.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Genie 4將互動世界模型推向更響應、具備音訊的體驗，但仍屬研究預覽。廣泛採用受Ultra訂閱限制，以及物理與長期一致性的已知局限。
items_flat.quote: This update unlocks first-time access to Genie 4, new upgrades to Genie 3, the Project Genie agent which helps users build their vision, and a community gallery.
items_flat.quote_zh: 此次更新首次解鎖Genie 4存取、Genie 3新升級、幫助用戶建構願景的Project Genie代理，以及社群畫廊。

items_flat.title_en: Meta launches personal AI agent Muse in Australia
items_flat.summary_en: Meta made its personal AI agent Muse available in Australia on November 17, described as the world’s first personal AI agent built for everyone. It handles email, schedules, and bookings, with local connectors rolling out progressively.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta於11月17日在澳洲推出個人AI代理Muse，描述為世界上第一個為每個人打造的個人AI代理。它處理電子郵件、行程與預訂，本地連接器正逐步推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: The Australia rollout expands Muse’s geographic footprint as Meta pushes agentic consumer products against rivals. Success depends on local partner density and reliable real-world task completion outside controlled demos.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 澳洲推出擴展了Muse的地理足跡，Meta正推動代理式消費產品與對手競爭。成功取決於本地合作夥伴密度，以及控制演示之外可靠的真實世界任務完成。
items_flat.quote: Muse Is Now Available in Australia: The World’s First Personal AI Agent Built for Everyone
items_flat.quote_zh: Muse現已在澳洲推出：為每個人打造的世界首個個人AI代理

items_flat.title_en: Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion Series C for AI drug discovery
items_flat.title_zh: Isomorphic Labs完成50億美元C輪融資，用於AI藥物發現
items_flat.summary_en: Isomorphic Labs, Alphabet’s AI-driven drug discovery company, raised $5 billion in a Series C co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia, with continued investment from Alphabet. The funding advances molecular biology modeling for therapeutic development.
items_flat.summary_zh: Alphabet旗下AI驅動藥物發現公司Isomorphic Labs完成50億美元C輪融資，由Greenoaks與Sequoia共同領投，Alphabet持續投資。資金推進分子生物學建模以開發治療方法。
items_flat.analysis_en: The large raise underscores continued capital flow into specialized AI science applications even as public markets price pure lab IPOs. Success hinges on clinical translation beyond computational advances.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 大規模融資突顯即使公開市場為純實驗室IPO定價，專業AI科學應用仍持續獲得資本流入。成功取決於超越計算進展的臨床轉化。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI partners with Le Groupe Figaro to bring journalism to ChatGPT
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI與Le Groupe Figaro合作，將新聞帶入ChatGPT
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced a partnership with Le Groupe Figaro on November 18 to make current and archive journalism from Le Figaro and related titles discoverable in ChatGPT via summaries and excerpts with links. The publisher retains full editorial control.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月18日宣布與Le Groupe Figaro合作，讓Le Figaro及相關刊物的當前與存檔新聞可透過摘要與摘錄加連結在ChatGPT中被發現。出版商保留完整編輯控制權。
items_flat.analysis_en: Media partnerships help OpenAI expand licensed content access while addressing publisher concerns over AI training and attribution. Impact on ChatGPT user experience depends on how prominently linked sources appear versus generated summaries.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 媒體合作幫助OpenAI擴展授權內容存取，同時回應出版商對AI訓練與歸因的擔憂。對ChatGPT用戶體驗的影響取決於連結來源相對於生成摘要的呈現顯著程度。
items_flat.quote: The collaboration will make Le Figaro’s journalism discoverable in ChatGPT using summaries and excerpts, including links to underlying stories.
items_flat.quote_zh: 此次合作將使Le Figaro的新聞以摘要與摘錄（包括指向原始故事的連結）在ChatGPT中可被發現。

items_flat.title_en: Meta welcomes Loblaw as first Canadian retail partner for Muse
items_flat.title_zh: Meta歡迎Loblaw成為Muse首家加拿大零售合作夥伴
items_flat.summary_en: On November 18 Meta announced Loblaw as the first Canadian retail partner for its Muse AI agent, expanding retail integrations for the personal assistant to enable product discovery and checkout at participating banners.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta於11月18日宣布Loblaw成為其Muse AI代理的首家加拿大零售合作夥伴，擴展零售整合，讓個人助理可在參與品牌進行產品發現與結帳。
items_flat.analysis_en: Retail partnerships accelerate Muse’s ability to handle real-world transactions and local services. Early Canadian rollout tests Meta’s agent ecosystem outside the US.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 零售合作加速Muse處理真實世界交易與本地服務的能力。早期加拿大推出測試Meta在美國以外的代理生態系統。
items_flat.quote: Meta Welcomes Loblaw as First Canadian Retail Partner to Muse
items_flat.quote_zh: Meta歡迎Loblaw成為Muse首個加拿大零售合作夥伴

anthropic.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC priced its initial public offering of its Class A common stock at $83.00 per share.
anthropic.quote_zh: 今日Anthropic, PBC將其A類普通股首次公開發行定價為每股83.00美元。

links.label: Anthropic IPO website / SEC filings via Stock Titan

google.title_en: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon for fast frontier-level task completion
google.title_zh: Google推出Gemini 4 Neon，實現快速前沿級任務完成
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 4 Neon on November 18, priced at $3/$15 per million tokens with a 1 million-token context window. It targets complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science with fast end-to-end completion, ranking #3 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at xhigh and #1 on the Coding Agent Index.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind於11月18日推出Gemini 4 Neon，定價為每百萬token 3/15美元，擁有100萬token上下文窗口。它針對複雜軟體工程、知識工作與科學，強調快速端到端完成，在Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index的xhigh設定排名第3，並在Coding Agent Index排名第1。
google.analysis_en: Neon fills a high-velocity tier between larger Gemini 4 models, emphasizing cost and speed for agentic workflows while claiming competitive benchmarks. Adoption will depend on real-world reliability in long-running production agents versus pure benchmark scores.
google.analysis_zh: Neon填補較大Gemini 4模型之間的高速度層級，強調代理工作流的成本與速度，同時宣稱具有競爭力的基準成績。採用將取決於長期生產代理中的實際可靠性，而非單純基準分數。
google.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Neon — bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work, and science workflows.
google.quote_zh: 今日，我們推出Gemini 4 Neon——為複雜軟體工程、知識工作與科學工作流帶來前沿級智能與快速端到端任務完成。

google.title_en: Google expands Gemini 4 Hydrogen for speed, agents, Tasks, and robotics
google.title_zh: Google擴展Gemini 4 Hydrogen，用於速度、代理、Tasks與機器人
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind’s Gemini 4 Hydrogen, introduced for everyday coding and agentic workflows at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens, is rolling out broadly in the Gemini app, Search, AI Studio, and API. It powers free Tasks in six countries and new robotics integrations.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind的Gemini 4 Hydrogen針對日常編碼與代理工作流推出，定價為每百萬token 1.50/7.50美元，正廣泛在Gemini應用、Search、AI Studio與API中推出。它支援六國免費Tasks與新機器人整合。
google.analysis_en: Hydrogen positions Google to compete on high-velocity agent and coding tasks while pairing with larger models like Carbon and Argon. Broader free access and robotics integration expand its reach beyond paid developer tiers.
google.analysis_zh: Hydrogen讓Google能在高速度代理與編碼任務上競爭，並與Carbon和Argon等較大模型搭配。更廣泛的免費存取與機器人整合，將其觸及範圍擴展至付費開發者層級之外。
google.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，將尖端智能帶給每個人——以速度與效率服務日常編碼與代理工作流。

google.title_en: Google rolls out Genie 4 in Project Genie for AI Ultra subscribers
google.title_zh: Google為AI Ultra訂閱者在Project Genie中推出Genie 4
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind made Genie 4 available on November 18 in an updated Project Genie experience for eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers. It adds real-time mid-session prompting, native audio, a creation agent, and a community gallery, alongside Genie 3 upgrades for longer sessions.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind於11月18日在更新的Project Genie體驗中為符合資格的Google AI Ultra訂閱者提供Genie 4。它加入即時會話中提示、原生音訊、創作代理與社群畫廊，並升級Genie 3以支援更長會話。
google.analysis_en: Genie 4 advances interactive world models toward more responsive, audio-enabled experiences while remaining in research preview. Broad adoption is constrained by the Ultra subscription gate and acknowledged limitations in physics and long-term consistency.
google.analysis_zh: Genie 4將互動世界模型推向更響應、具備音訊的體驗，但仍屬研究預覽。廣泛採用受Ultra訂閱限制，以及物理與長期一致性的已知局限。
google.quote: This update unlocks first-time access to Genie 4, new upgrades to Genie 3, the Project Genie agent which helps users build their vision, and a community gallery.
google.quote_zh: 此次更新首次解鎖Genie 4存取、Genie 3新升級、幫助用戶建構願景的Project Genie代理，以及社群畫廊。

meta.title_en: Meta launches personal AI agent Muse in Australia
meta.summary_en: Meta made its personal AI agent Muse available in Australia on November 17, described as the world’s first personal AI agent built for everyone. It handles email, schedules, and bookings, with local connectors rolling out progressively.
meta.summary_zh: Meta於11月17日在澳洲推出個人AI代理Muse，描述為世界上第一個為每個人打造的個人AI代理。它處理電子郵件、行程與預訂，本地連接器正逐步推出。
meta.analysis_en: The Australia rollout expands Muse’s geographic footprint as Meta pushes agentic consumer products against rivals. Success depends on local partner density and reliable real-world task completion outside controlled demos.
meta.analysis_zh: 澳洲推出擴展了Muse的地理足跡，Meta正推動代理式消費產品與對手競爭。成功取決於本地合作夥伴密度，以及控制演示之外可靠的真實世界任務完成。
meta.quote: Muse Is Now Available in Australia: The World’s First Personal AI Agent Built for Everyone
meta.quote_zh: Muse現已在澳洲推出：為每個人打造的世界首個個人AI代理

meta.title_en: Meta welcomes Loblaw as first Canadian retail partner for Muse
meta.title_zh: Meta歡迎Loblaw成為Muse首家加拿大零售合作夥伴
meta.summary_en: On November 18 Meta announced Loblaw as the first Canadian retail partner for its Muse AI agent, expanding retail integrations for the personal assistant to enable product discovery and checkout at participating banners.
meta.summary_zh: Meta於11月18日宣布Loblaw成為其Muse AI代理的首家加拿大零售合作夥伴，擴展零售整合，讓個人助理可在參與品牌進行產品發現與結帳。
meta.analysis_en: Retail partnerships accelerate Muse’s ability to handle real-world transactions and local services. Early Canadian rollout tests Meta’s agent ecosystem outside the US.
meta.analysis_zh: 零售合作加速Muse處理真實世界交易與本地服務的能力。早期加拿大推出測試Meta在美國以外的代理生態系統。
meta.quote: Meta Welcomes Loblaw as First Canadian Retail Partner to Muse
meta.quote_zh: Meta歡迎Loblaw成為Muse首個加拿大零售合作夥伴

frontier_other.title_en: Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion Series C for AI drug discovery
frontier_other.title_zh: Isomorphic Labs完成50億美元C輪融資，用於AI藥物發現
frontier_other.summary_en: Isomorphic Labs, Alphabet’s AI-driven drug discovery company, raised $5 billion in a Series C co-led by Greenoaks and Sequoia, with continued investment from Alphabet. The funding advances molecular biology modeling for therapeutic development.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Alphabet旗下AI驅動藥物發現公司Isomorphic Labs完成50億美元C輪融資，由Greenoaks與Sequoia共同領投，Alphabet持續投資。資金推進分子生物學建模以開發治療方法。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The large raise underscores continued capital flow into specialized AI science applications even as public markets price pure lab IPOs. Success hinges on clinical translation beyond computational advances.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 大規模融資突顯即使公開市場為純實驗室IPO定價，專業AI科學應用仍持續獲得資本流入。成功取決於超越計算進展的臨床轉化。

brief_en: Anthropic prices record $81.3B IPO at $83/share for ~$1.5T valuation, with ANT trading set to open today. Google ships Gemini 4 Neon for fast frontier task completion and expands Genie 4 world models. OpenAI details AI-driven chip design gains and research acceleration data while GPT-6.2 rolls out.
brief_zh: Anthropic以每股83美元定價史上最大IPO，募資813億美元、估值約1.5兆美元，ANT今日開始交易。Google推出Gemini 4 Neon快速完成複雜任務，並擴展Genie 4世界模型。OpenAI公布AI輔助晶片設計進展與研究加速數據，GPT-6.2持續推廣。
